_comment: Crafting outcome + XP tuning (see include/Crafting.h). Consumable outcome quality = scaling.base + quality_per_stat*craftStat + a luck roll in [0, quality_luck], clamped to quality_max. XP feeds the recipe's stat INVERSE to mastery: factor = clamp(xp_reach_gain*quality - xp_mastery_falloff*craftStat + 1, xp_floor, xp_ceiling), so reaching above your level pays more and routine work pays little. learn_* is the one-time reward for DISCOVERING a recipe (its first successful craft): learn_faculty_exp EXP into learn_faculty + learn_spirit_exp Spirit EXP. The craft's own XP goes to the recipe's xp_stat, so making things grows the doing layer the way observing grows a faculty. Coefficients only; the math lives in code. Tunable -- edit + relaunch (dev reads assets from source).
